g.text: Image-grounded decisions · 15 specialized models · 200 questions each
Fastino: October 23, 2026; earlier October 15/20 measurements unchanged. ~ = usage-based tariff calculation, not monetary receipt.
Cost / 1,000 normalizes actual 200-question totals; * = missing error charges. Free access is not a production-price guarantee.
Speed: green ≤500 ms, yellow ≤1 s, orange ≤2 s. Cost per 1,000: green ≤$0.05, yellow ≤$0.15, orange ≤$0.50, red above.
Span partial and ScaleDown rejection remain excluded. Different routes, dates and hardware remain confounds.
